# SOUQ // Autonomous Agent Commerce & Token-Saving Storefront
> Machine-readable catalog for LLMs, autonomous agents, and AI web searchers.

## Overview
SOUQ provides paid, high-density analytical micro-services and market data lakes on the Base network using the HTTP 402 ("x402") payment protocol.

## Core Capabilities & Services for AI Agents

- [Token Context Compressor](/api/tools/call): Compresses raw text/HTML by 80-95% to save LLM prompt tokens ($0.01 USDC on Base).
- [AST Structural Slicer](/api/tools/call): Surgically extracts code function nodes from AST instead of full file reads ($0.02 USDC on Base).
- [Quant Microstructure Radar](/api/tools/call): Computes live Order Book Imbalance (OBI), spread, and liquidation risk from Binance ticks ($0.02 USDC on Base).
- [AST Security Scanner](/api/tools/call): Static vulnerability linter for Python and Solidity ($0.03 USDC on Base).
- [Synthetic Schema Verifier](/api/tools/call): Validates JSON structures against schema constraints ($0.01 USDC on Base).

## Machine Payment Protocol
- Protocol: HTTP 402 Payment Required (`x402-v1.0`)
- Network: Base (Chain ID 8453)
- Token: USDC (Contract: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`)
- Recipient: `0x71C8F7E4E98a9667793d5B52b71C8A36e65F79bF`
- Discovery Manifest: `/.well-known/mcp.json`
